title: Bad Quality Control
text:
Bad Quality Control. Cuisinart has long been a respected name in kitchen wares, particularly in appliances and with stainless steel utensils. I was excited to get an opportunity to evaluate this pizza peel as I make pizza on a semi-frequent basis in my kitchen and I need a peel to Get the pizza on and off the stone in the oven. I have a cheap peel that has worked well for me for years and my expectations were high for this Cuisinart peel. Unfortunately, this peel has let me down, particularly in the finish.

This is a beautiful peel in terms of materials. The wood is darker than that of my other peel and it has a finish on it to make it smooth and slightly shiny. This finish is where the problem lies with his peel. The finish is not even and it looks like the peel was set down somewhere when the finish was still wet as there is an obvious mark indicative of making contact with another surface. The mark is rough and unbaked dough catches on it when sliding a pizza into the oven. It is a shame - this could have been avoided with a little bit of sanding before it left the manufacturer. I can certainly fix it, but I shouldn’t have to.

Otherwise, this is not a bad peel. Others have reported cracked wood and shoddy finish, and while they may be true the only issue I have with mine is the finish being rough. It supports the size of pizza I like to make and it does a good job of allowing me to remove a pizza from the oven without trouble.

I have read a number of the other reviews and many point out flaws with this peel. Mine was flawed, but in a different way than what other reviewers have shared. This means something important - if you choose this peel, inspect it very carefully for problems as there seems to be some issues with quality control.

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart CPP-451 Rustic Pizza Peel, Brown
description: The pizza peel is the most essential tool in a pizza maker's arsenal. It provides a generous surface to construct your unique pizza creations and allow you to deliver your pizza right into the oven smoothly. While your delicious pie bakes, the peel can also be used to rotate, lift, check and maneuver your pizza as needed. When you're done, the peel makes short work of lifting, removing and serving your perfect pizza. Features: Beautiful stained Acacia Wood construction.|Generous 13" x 13" pizza making surface.|7" curved handle with hanging hole.
